rv.q: The script valuably sheds light on that process but Cranney’s play hops through Mat’s life too quickly to have a potent impact.
The plodding rhythm stomps out significant plot developments, flattening the shape of the play into a barely perceptible steady incline.
It’s hard to praise Attachment enough.

cn.t: Critics are sharply divided on this adoption-focused monologue, with some hailing Paislie Reid's performance as exceptional and the themes as powerfully handled, while others find the production flat and monotonous.
